paper.central_claim: SyncLoop: a closed-loop self-improving framework that jointly evolves multimodal (diagram+text) geometry training data and the MLLM, via a cross-modal data-evolution loop and an error-rate-filtered data-model loop alternating SFT and GRPO, yielding gains on Geo-Sub/MathVista/MathVerse with <1% of the data.
paper.title: SyncLoop: A Multimodal Dual-Loop Framework for Self-Improving Mathematical Reasoning

reason: Improver update object and product are both model weights (SFT+GRPO on Qwen2-VL-2B/7B). The evolved synthetic dataset is produced by external GPT-4o/Doubao/DeepSeek-R1 and consumed only as weight-training input; no prompt/skill/tool/workflow/memory/evaluator/config is retained or reused across tasks. Per frozen rubric A3 and EVIDENCE.md exclusion (weight-updating self-improvement) this is out of Harness-RSI scope.

evidence.quote: the latter loop adaptively selects the generated problems based on the performance of the base model, to conduct supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning alternately
evidence.support_explanation: Retained product of the loop is a fine-tuned model; selection of data serves weight updates.

evidence.quote: we employ two reward rules in conjunction with the GRPO algorithm to further refine the policy model
evidence.support_explanation: Weight update by RL is the improvement operator.

evidence.quote: GPT-4o is employed to generate auxiliary construction code
evidence.support_explanation: Data evolution is driven by external stronger models, not by the improved system's own harness.

signatures.object: Qwen2-VL model weights, trained on evolved geometry dataset
signatures.information: Image/question/answer triplets from Geometry3k; external oracle models generate auxiliary-line diagrams, sub-problems and answers; 32-sample error rate of current model
signatures.operation: Synthesize harder diagram+question pairs with external LLMs; keep samples with majority-consistent answers; select by model error rate >=0.3; SFT then GRPO
signatures.feedback: Rule-based answer-accuracy and format reward; model error rate
signatures.persistence: Weights only; dataset is training input
signatures.later_use: Next iteration trains from updated weights
signatures.failure_boundary: Authors note catastrophic forgetting signs and synthetic-data bias

gap.author_gap: Visual and textual complexity are evolved separately, and data difficulty is not matched to evolving model capability.
gap.lineage/closest_adjacent: OpenVLThinker, MM-EUREKA, R-CoT, MAVIS (per paper related work)
unresolved: Gap not scored because paper is out of scope
